nodes.label: Inter Variable Font
nodes.rationale: Headlines, interface and readouts; drawn at 93% size-adjust so lines match the replaced Outfit and no layout moved.

nodes.label: Electron Desktop App Build
nodes.rationale: Dashboard runs as a localhost website in development and as an Electron app (Windows installer via npm run dist) for desktop use.

nodes.label: Self-Hosted @font-face (no next/font)
nodes.rationale: next/font rejects the production assetPrefix './' that the Electron build needs, so fonts are self-hosted via @font-face in app/globals.css.

nodes.label: Command Prompt (GLM via OpenRouter)
nodes.rationale: English/Tagalog/Taglish commands become 21 proposed actions applied only on Apply; server re-checks every field; model z-ai/glm-5.3-flash paid per token; eval 80/80.

nodes.label: adapter.ts composeInterventions
nodes.rationale: The ONE pure function deciding what the engine holds from operator settings plus scenario events; also scheduling, ownership, EngineBinding and UI views.

nodes.label: assumptions.ts (recorded Assumptions)
nodes.rationale: Every value not from NLEX data is a recorded Assumption with reason, evidence and what would settle it.

nodes.label: bothMetrics.ts corridor totals
nodes.rationale: Sum for counts/rates, max for longest queue, flow-weighted speed (never plain mean), no total for density; flow-weighting hides a blocked carriageway, by design.

nodes.label: eventTwin.ts NoEventTwin
nodes.rationale: UAT SB-17: before/after now compares the same deterministic run without events, so differences are the events' and not traffic drift.

nodes.label: Calibrated vs Manual-Only Scenario Families
nodes.rationale: 5 families calibrated from NLEX data; overturned, flooding, roadworks and rain are manual-only because exports lack categories or show no real clearance difference.

nodes.label: Open Questions for NLEX (LANE1_IS_INNERMOST, CHAINAGE_OFFSET_KM, buffers, MULTI_DEPLOYMENT_RULE)
nodes.norm_label: open questions for nlex (lane1_is_innermost, chainage_offset_km, buffers, multi_deployment_rule)

nodes.label: Forecast Incidents on the Stretch (forecastIncidents.ts)
nodes.rationale: Hourly corridor forecast (~134/day) scaled by carriageway share (~27%), stretch share and NB/SB split, drawn Poisson and seeded by day/hour/direction/stretch.

nodes.label: Lane Reallocation (opposite-bound lane transfer)
nodes.rationale: Engine cannot vary lane count along the road or mid-run, so the chosen stretch becomes the simulated road and both runs restart; 150 m crossovers are a modelling choice.

nodes.label: sceneMarks / SceneMark (closure ownership drawing)
nodes.rationale: An event is drawn holding lanes only if it owns the closure, so the picture never shows something the engine is not honouring.

nodes.label: Scenes Made of the Traffic (SCENE_LEAD_S run-up)
nodes.norm_label: scenes made of the traffic (scene_lead_s run-up)
nodes.rationale: Every scene vehicle was real traffic picked 12 s ahead (crashAt, doom); responders use the hard shoulder because lane entry behind a closure never got a gap.

nodes.label: No Limit on Simultaneous Events (multiple closures/speed zones)
nodes.norm_label: no limit on simultaneous events (multiple closures/speed zones)
nodes.rationale: At the adviser's request; Interventions carries closures and speedZones lists, engine uses closureList() and the lowest overlapping limit.

nodes.label: Mejia & Sigua (2018) Rainfall Impacts on NLEx Traffic Flow
nodes.norm_label: mejia & sigua (2018) rainfall impacts on nlex traffic flow

nodes.label: Class-Filtered Blockage (flood placeholder)
nodes.rationale: Engine closure is binary across classes, so flooding as closed lanes is a placeholder; real flood impact is class-dependent.

nodes.label: directionBucketsConsistent / addEventToBucket
nodes.rationale: Direction is stored both as a field and as the bucket so drift is detectable; enforced at storage.

nodes.label: Independent Carriageways Modelling Limitation
nodes.rationale: Two TrafficSim instances never interact and each has its own clock, so corridor totals can mix simulated moments; suggested fix is showing each direction's elapsedS and marking totals stale.

nodes.label: Motorcycle Share of Class 1 (1.28%)
nodes.rationale: 944 of 73,662 Class 1 breakdown records; a picture not a model, changes no metric; fact_traffic_hourly has no motorcycle count.

nodes.label: Rain Intensity Speed Cap (100/100/96 km/h)
nodes.rationale: Engine free-flow 108 km/h scaled by the study's rain-to-clear ratio; a speed cap is a proxy and understates capacity loss since headways cannot vary. Replaced invented 90/75/60.

nodes.label: replicate() Confidence Runs refused with events
nodes.norm_label: replicate() confidence runs refused with events
nodes.rationale: replicate() replays static Interventions, which timed phases don't fit, so confidence runs are refused rather than silently misrepresenting events.

nodes.label: Scenario Events Layer over Engine Interventions
nodes.norm_label: scenario events layer over engine interventions
nodes.rationale: Incident events drive the existing engine levers (closedLanes, closurePoint, incidents, speedLimitKmh, speedZone) on a schedule; simulation.ts, Back-End and replicate() are never modified, it only composes engine inputs.

nodes.label: Seeds by Direction (12345, +7919)
nodes.rationale: Widely spaced seeds because adjacent mulberry32 seeds can correlate and would sync arrival bursts across carriageways; NB keeps 12345 for reproducibility.

nodes.label: Fast-Forward Skip Guard (SKIP_COST_FACTOR)
nodes.rationale: Pessimistic upper bound (factor 2.5) warns before skips over two minutes; measured 0.27x-3.98x the bare prediction.

nodes.label: createNlexMascotModel.ts factory
nodes.rationale: Constants in this file are the source of truth since v2; the sculpt spec no longer matches.

nodes.label: mascot3d.ts stage actor
nodes.rationale: Falls back to the 2.5D PNG if the model fails, device memory < 4 GB, or reduced motion is on.

nodes.label: Mascot Design Iterations v2-v8
nodes.rationale: Exposure 1.35 not 2.2 because ACES washed paint to lilac; soft contact ellipse instead of shadow map to avoid hard edges and a second render.
